fit.summary: Strong statistics training and one real operations project; no paid analyst work yet.

bullets.text: Recommended moving 12 bikes each morning; the campus pilot cut empty-station reports 50%

cover_letter.hook: Scheduling staff and supplies around patient volume across 11 locations is the kind of problem I studied for.
cover_letter.body:
For my capstone I modeled 2 years of campus bike share trips in R to find the 5 stations that ran empty most often (example.com/alexchen/bike-share). The campus ran a pilot on my recommendation and empty-station reports fell by half.

I also built an Excel inventory sheet that a volunteer food pantry uses for 300 weekly visits.
cover_letter.close: I would like to learn how your clinics forecast patient volume today.

gaps: No paid work history yet; Python is listed and Alex has not used it.
